hook: GHMC's *782 acres* of waste sites stuck after 19 filings
hook_b: GHMC's *782 acres* of waste sites stuck after 19 filings
tldr: A GHMC report to the NGT lists 19 filings since 2021 and blockers at all four outskirts sites.

beats.what: Land transfer is pending at one site, work is halted by court order at another, pollution consent pending at a third, land-use conversion awaited at the fourth.
beats.why: Litigation over Hyderabad's garbage disposal reached the National Green Tribunal five years ago.
beats.care: Delays in new processing sites keep pressure on how the city handles its waste.
